Messages.Author: René P. Steurs
Messages.Body:
Hi you all,

Maybe it seems stupid, but I always compare the pictures and the names
of the cards with their text (maneuver, press, stealth,...).

When you "box in" your 'prey', how can you use that press to end
combat ??
So I think (IMHO) that the press on Boxed In has to be an press, only
usable to continue combat...

Maybe, I'm just missing something, I don't know.

What do you think ??

---Maarten <Rene.Steurs<ping.be>---

Messages.Body:

It's probably best envisioned as "trapping" the other minion in a corner,
then spinning around and retreating. By the time the other minion has
figured out what's going on, you've gotten away (unless, of course, the
other minion presses to continue...)
